title: Bus shelter poster proposal
slide_intent: Test a mark beside real artwork at street scale because recognition and exhibition content must remain legible together.
strategic_value: A thin W above the Glenn Ligon image can identify the museum while leaving the work visually dominant.
demonstration: A street photograph contains a bus shelter montage with Whitney, exhibition text, a W and a dark artwork reproduction.
practical_value: Compare identity area and artwork area within an outdoor format; treat this as a 2012 proposal rather than an installed campaign.

content_islands.name: Street setting
content_islands.spec: Retain the shelter, pavement and surrounding buildings as scale context.

content_islands.name: Poster
content_islands.spec: Place the white identity and title band above the dark artwork within the shelter frame.

reference_purposes.Application: The source caption explicitly identifies a possible bus shelter poster montage from 2012.
reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying essay explains the museum’s commitment to artwork primacy and single-image exhibition promotion.
